name: Ocean County, NJ
findings: Ocean County has 2,356 nonprofit organizations. 687 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 541 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Ocean County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
